name: Isurugi Mei
source:
"Heyoooo! I heard you're handing out boyfriends down here!"

A hyper-energetic girl who lives on vibes alone.

She's endlessly cheerful and friendly, but her comedic instincts often go overboard.

A cheerful, clueless girl who hasn't even made it to the starting line as a woman, let alone in romance—

she came to the matchmaking agency thinking it was a place where they'd simply hand her a boyfriend.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3862740/Love_Advisor_Youre_a_mess_and_I_adore_you/]Steam[/url]]
